title: El castillo: El Ausente, El Castigado y El Montón
description: docs/castle.md § Bestiary. The last three pupils, each in its room from the fight tester (Gerard in Matemágico, Aitor in Papagato, free maná, no PV lost): El Ausente with El Repetidor and its «Presente», El Empollón with El Castigado and its Rabia, El Montón with La Chivata and the blow it copies. The party holds on so the foes' turns play for real. Run it with --gpu.

steps.eval: navigator.getGamepads = () => []; window.ui = window.gerard.battleUI; window.ready = () => ui.fight && ui.fight.phase === 'player' && !ui.fight.busy && !document.querySelector('#battle[data-entering]') && document.activeElement?.matches('.command-trigger'); window.cmd = id => document.querySelector('[data-command="' + id + '"] .command-trigger').click(); window.foe = kind => ui.live.foes.find(f => f.kind === kind); window.closeUp = (id, d) => { const p = window.gerard.game.fighterAt(id); window.gerard.game.frame({ x: p.x, y: p.y, z: p.z }, d || 4.2); };

steps.caption: Second year: El Ausente and El Repetidor. El Ausente's plate: «Ausente: no se le puede pegar»
